# Scientific Advisory Committee {.people-eyebrow-heading}

ODEKA's Scientific Advisory Committee provides guidance on the organization's scientific strategy, research design, and long-term development.
<!-- ============================ -->

<div style="clear: both;">
</div>
<br>

<div class="person-photo">
  <img src="faces/robinson.jpeg" alt="James Robinson">
</div>

<div class="person-info">
<div class="person-name">
  James Robinson
</div>

<div class="person-title">
  Member
</div>

<p>A Nobel Prize laureate, James Robinson is a professor at the University of Chicago’s Harris School of Public Policy and Department of Political Science. His research examines the political and institutional foundations of development and the historical roots of prosperity and poverty.

<div class="person-link">
<a href="https://harris.uchicago.edu/directory/james-robinson" target="_blank">
  UChicago Profile
</a>
</div>
</div>

<!-- ============================ -->

<div style="clear: both;">
</div>
<br>

<div class="person-photo">
  <img src="faces/nunn.jpeg" alt="Nathan Nunn">
</div>

<div class="person-info">
<div class="person-name">
  Nathan Nunn
</div>

<div class="person-title">
  Member
</div>

<p>Nathan Nunn is a professor at the Vancouver School of Economics. His research explores the historical and cultural foundations of economic development and how local contexts shape the effectiveness of policies and institutions.

<div class="person-link">
<a href="https://nathannunn.arts.ubc.ca" target="_blank">
  UBC Profile
</a>
</div>
</div>

<!-- ============================ -->

<div style="clear: both;">
</div>
<br>

<div class="person-photo">
  <img src="faces/lowes.jpg" alt="Sara Lowes">
</div>

<div class="person-info">
<div class="person-name">
  Sara Lowes
</div>

<div class="person-title">
  Member
</div>

<p>Sara Lowes is an associate professor of economics at the University of California, San Diego. Her research sits at the intersection of development economics, economic history, and political economy, examining how culture and institutions shape development outcomes.

<div class="person-link">
<a href="https://economics.ucsd.edu/faculty-and-research/faculty-profiles/lowes.html" target="_blank">
  UCSD Profile
</a>
</div>
</div>

<!-- ============================ -->

<div style="clear: both;">
</div>
<br>

<div class="person-photo">
  <img src="faces/tourek.jpeg" alt="Gabriel Tourek">
</div>

<div class="person-info">
<div class="person-name">
  Gabriel Tourek
</div>

<div class="person-title">
  Member
</div>

<p>Gabriel Tourek is an assistant professor of economics at the University of California, Davis. His research focuses on public finance and development economics, with an emphasis on state capacity and governance in low-income countries.

<div class="person-link">
<a href="https://economics.ucdavis.edu/people/gabriel-tourek" target="_blank">
  UC Davis Profile
</a>
</div>
</div>

<!-- ============================ -->

<div style="clear: both;">
</div>
<br>

<div class="person-photo">
  <img src="faces/ngoma.jpg" alt="Marina Ngoma Mavungu">
</div>

<div class="person-info">
<div class="person-name">
  Marina Ngoma Mavungu
</div>

<div class="person-title">
  Member
</div>

<p>Marina Ngoma Mavungu is an economist at the World Bank, specializing in economic development with a focus on private sector policies, industrialization, regional integration, public finance, and institutions.

<div class="person-link">
<a href="https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/people/m/marina-ngoma-mavungu" target="_blank">
  World Bank Profile
</a>
</div>
</div>

<!-- ============================ -->

<div style="clear: both;">
</div>
